items.text: Document title uses a brand-name-plus-tagline pattern separated by an em dash, and the tagline repeats the H1 word for word.
items.evidence: title 'STG Partners — Partners for Business Transformation'; h1 'Partners for Business Transformation'

items.text: The page has exactly one H1, followed by four H2 section headings and eleven H3s.
items.evidence: h1_count 1; tag_counts h2: 4, h3: 11

items.text: Helvetica Neue is the only font family in use, with no web-font stylesheet loaded.
items.evidence: fonts_by_element_count [['Helvetica Neue',128]]; stylesheets 0; h1 font_family '"Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif'

items.text: Card titles and news headlines use a heavier weight than the light H2s, which creates weight contrast between levels.
items.evidence: Slice 1: 'Customer Centric' and 'Accelerators' in bold white; slice 2: news titles in medium-weight dark text

items.text: Each section starts with a small, uppercase, widely letter-spaced eyebrow label in blue above its H2.
items.evidence: Labels 'OUR APPROACH', 'PORTFOLIO', 'WHO WE ARE' and 'NEWS' in blue (rgb(63,167,214) is among top_text_colors)

items.text: Navigation links and button labels are uppercase with letter-spacing.
items.evidence: Header nav 'OUR APPROACH PORTFOLIO WHO WE ARE NEWS CONTACT'; buttons 'OUR APPROACH', 'VIEW OUR WORK', 'READ MORE'

items.text: Light sections alternate between white and a very pale blue-grey band.
items.evidence: top_backgrounds rgb(245,247,250) ×2 (Portfolio and News sections) and rgb(255,255,255); body_bg white

items.text: A single bright cyan-blue serves as the accent colour, used for eyebrows, 'READ MORE' links, the 'Learn more.' link and the arrow in the announcement bar.
items.evidence: top_text_colors rgb(63,167,214) ×11; visible in slices 1–2 and in the bar arrow in slice 0

items.text: Body text is a dark navy-slate, not pure black.
items.evidence: body_color rgb(26,36,51)

items.text: Secondary text on dark backgrounds uses muted blue-greys.
items.evidence: top_text_colors rgb(199,209,222) ×21 and rgb(185,197,212) ×6; card descriptions and hero subtext appear greyish

items.text: Corners are almost all square, with a few small radii of 1–7px.
items.evidence: border_radius_buckets bucket_0 119, bucket_1_7 9, others 0; cards show slightly rounded corners

items.text: One element uses backdrop blur, which matches the translucent navy header.
items.evidence: backdrop_blur 1; background rgba(14,27,46,0.96) in top_backgrounds; header in slice 0 is slightly lighter than the hero

items.text: No gradients, box shadows, animations or transforms are used; the page depends on flat colour fields.
items.evidence: gradient_backgrounds 0; box_shadows 0; animations 0; transforms 0

items.text: A 'Menu' button exists in the DOM but does not show at desktop width; it has a transparent background, a 3px radius and 8px 14px padding.
items.evidence: primary_button text 'Menu', bg rgba(0,0,0,0), radius 3px, padding 8px 14px; not visible in slice 0

items.text: The hero is a text-only navy block with a left-aligned H1 that wraps to two lines, a subheading and one outlined button.
items.evidence: Slice 0: 'Partners for Business Transformation', subtext 'A private equity firm focused on…', white-outlined 'OUR APPROACH' button

items.text: All buttons are ghost/outline buttons: a thin border with no fill. They are white-bordered on dark backgrounds and dark-bordered on light ones.
items.evidence: 'OUR APPROACH' (slice 0), 'VIEW OUR WORK' and 'READ MORE' (slices 1–2) are all outlined rectangles

items.text: A full-bleed team photo sits below the hero, spanning the whole 1440px viewport width at 630px tall.
items.evidence: image-01.png rect x0 w1440 h630, natural 1439×630; y 562

items.text: The photo has a descriptive alt text.
items.evidence: alt 'The STG Partners leadership team standing together in a bright office'; alt_missing 0

items.text: A thin navy announcement bar under the photo holds a centred news headline and a cyan arrow.
items.evidence: Slice 0: 'McAfee Announces Sale of Enterprise Business to Symphony Technology Group for $4.0 Billion →' on rgb(21,38,61)-like band

items.text: The 'Our Approach' and 'Who We Are' sections use a split layout: the heading sits in the left column and a 2×2 or 1×2 card grid fills the right.
items.evidence: Slice 1: heading on the left, four cards at x≈683–1244; slice 2: Experts/Innovators cards on the right

items.text: Feature cards are dark navy tiles with a white line icon, a bold white title and grey description text.
items.evidence: Cards 'Customer Centric', 'Committed to Growth', 'Engaged Partners', 'Accelerators', 'Experts', 'Innovators'

items.text: Card icons are SVG files loaded through tags, all rendered at 52×52 even though their natural sizes differ.

items.text: Icons are thin-stroke outline illustrations: a hand holding a person, an up arrow in a circle, a dot pyramid, lines with nodes, a network graph and a lightbulb.
items.evidence: Slices 1–2 card icons

items.text: Card heights in a row follow the tallest card, leaving empty space in cards with shorter copy.
items.evidence: Slice 1: 'Engaged Partners' card has empty space below short text, matching the height of the 'Accelerators' card

items.text: Only the 'Accelerators' card has an inline link, styled as underlined cyan text.
items.evidence: Slice 1: 'Learn more.' underlined in blue

items.evidence: Slice 1: 'Building strategic value for market leading companies', 'Software, data and analytics.', 'VIEW OUR WORK'

items.text: Content is held in a centred container about 1048px wide, from x≈196 to x≈1244 on a 1440px page.

items.text: Sections have large vertical padding of roughly 100px or more.
items.evidence: Slices 1–2: wide spacing between the Portfolio band edges and its content, and between sections

items.text: Each news row has a date block on the left (a small uppercase month above a large light-weight day number), a headline in the middle and a cyan 'READ MORE' on the right.

items.text: Long news headlines wrap to two lines while the date and link stay vertically centred.

items.text: News copy is about acquisitions and partnerships of portfolio companies.

items.text: Semantic landmarks are used: header, main, four sections and footer. There are no article, aside or figure elements.

items.text: There are six ARIA attributes and no inline style attributes.
items.evidence: aria_attrs 6; inline_style_attrs 0

items.text: Copy is short: 237 words, with no emoji, no exclamation marks and no em dashes in the body text.

items.text: The page is about 3931px tall, and the footer extends into the final short slice.

items.text: Bold text appears through five <b> elements, and there are no strong tags.

items.text: The section headings are sentence-case value statements. Section labels are separate one-word eyebrows.
items.evidence: 'Built around people and long-term growth', 'Business builders with deep sector expertise', 'Latest from STG and our companies'

items.text: The page is mostly text and flat colour, with one photograph. Section variety comes from background banding and card clusters, not from imagery.

features.statement: Document title combines brand name and tagline with an em dash, and the tagline repeats the H1 text.
Heading hierarchy is clean: a single H1, few H2 section headings, and more numerous H3 card or item titles.
A single sans-serif font family (Helvetica Neue stack) is used throughout, with no web-font loading.
Light-weight large headings contrast with bolder or medium-weight card titles and headlines, creating weight hierarchy between levels.
Each section opens with a small uppercase, widely letter-spaced accent-coloured eyebrow label above the heading.
Navigation links and button labels are set in uppercase with letter-spacing.
Light sections alternate between white and a very pale blue-grey background band.
One bright cyan-blue accent colour is reused for eyebrows, text links, read-more links and arrows against a navy palette.
Body text is dark navy-slate rather than pure black, and secondary text on dark backgrounds uses muted blue-greys.
Corners are mostly square, with only small radii of a few pixels on a handful of elements.
Design is flat: no gradients, box shadows, animations or transforms, relying on solid colour fields.
A translucent dark header uses backdrop blur.
All buttons are ghost/outline rectangles with thin borders and no fill, white on dark and dark on light.
Hero is a text-only dark block with left-aligned H1, a subheading and a single outlined button.
A full-bleed photograph spans the viewport width beneath the hero, with descriptive alt text.
A thin dark announcement bar holds a centred headline and an accent-coloured arrow.
Sections use a split layout with the heading in the left column and a card grid on the right.
Feature cards are dark navy tiles with a white line icon, bold white title and grey description.
Icons are thin-stroke outline illustrations, loaded as external SVG images displayed at a uniform size.
Inline text links are underlined in the accent colour.
Some sections are text-only, with an eyebrow, short heading, subline and button, no imagery.
Content sits in a centred container about 1050px wide on a wide viewport.
Sections have generous vertical padding of about 100px or more.
News rows show a date block on the left, headline in the middle, and accent read-more link on the right, vertically centred.
Footer is dark with a wordmark, uppercase links, and a horizontal rule above the copyright row.
Semantic landmarks (header, main, sections, footer) and ul/li lists are used, without article, aside or figure.
Styling lives in a single embedded style block with no inline styles or utility-class framework.
Copy is concise and plain, with no emoji, exclamation marks or em dashes in the body text.
Section headings are sentence-case value statements, with separate one-word eyebrow labels.
The brand mark is a bold, wide-tracked text wordmark in header and footer rather than an image.
